title: Working with Stored Procedures
description: Learn to execute stored procedures using FromSql and ExecuteSqlCommand.

data.text: EF Core provides two methods to execute stored procedures: `FromSql()` for queries returning entities and `ExecuteSqlCommand()` for non-query operations.

data.title: FromSql Example
data.content: Executing stored procedure that returns entities

items: Result must be an entity type
Must return all columns of the table
CUD operations cannot be mapped to SaveChanges

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Has limitations on result type and columns
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about Database-First approach.
